mentions.name: Foqos
mentions.description: App blocker that helps users restrict access to distracting apps, with recently added features including QR code gating, breaks, and manual app blocking, plus a redesigned interface.
mentions.source_excerpt: I launched Foqos here a few months back: https://github.com/awaseem/foqos and just working on the feedback. Since then added QR codes, breaks, ability to block apps manually and even a mini redesign.
